name: grill-me-jewel
description: An adaptive jewelry interview that turns vague ideas into confirmed briefs and real Codex design images.

interface.shortDescription: 通过按需访谈明确方向，确认后生成珠宝设计图。
interface.longDescription: Grill Me Jewel asks only unresolved design decisions, with optional full-depth interviews, then confirms the brief, delivery count, and presentation before generating independent jewelry images with Codex.
defaultPrompt: 我只有一个模糊的珠宝想法，请先用表单梳理，再生成设计图。
